profile.summary: Orion Academy is a private, nonprofit high school for students in grades 9-12 whose learning is affected by autism spectrum disorder and executive functioning challenges. It offers a college preparatory special education program that also teaches language and social skills and independent living skills. It is approved as a nonpublic school by the State of California and moved from Moraga to Concord in 2022.
